Might,Ⓒs.ⒹbalaM, Sakti f., sAmarTyaM, tejas n., SOryaM, vi-parA-kramaH, praBAvaH; See Strength; ‘with all oneʼs m(ight)’ yaTASakti, yAvacCakyaM
Ⓝ[Might]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓprabala, Saktimat, balavat, ojasvin, Urjasvala, vikrAMta, balin; uruvikrama; See Strong.
Ⓑ
 2 mahat, viSAla, pratApavat, mahOjas, viBUtimat; ‘m(ighty) lord’ maheSvaraH, aDISvaraH.
Ⓝ[Might]ily,Ⓒadv.Ⓓbalena, vikrameRa, SOryeRa.
Ⓑ
 2 atIva, atyaMtaM, balavat, BfSaM, atimAtraM.
Ⓝ[Might]iness,Ⓒs.ⒹsAmarTyaM, praBAvaH, vIryaM; See (s.).

Migrate,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓnirgam 1 P, Bram 1, 4 P, deSAMtaraM-sTAnAMtaraM-gam or aDi-vas 1 P or aDyAs 2 A.
Ⓝ[Migrat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹBramaRaM, paryawanaM, deSAMtaragamanaM.
Ⓝ[Migrat]ory,Ⓒa.ⒹdeSaBramaRa-paryawana-SIla.
